title: Unified MCP server: merge + P0-P2 improvements
purpose: Single FastMCP server 'nosai-mcp-unified' that replaces both scripts/mcp_server.py and nosai/mcp/server.py. Adds P0: CircuitBreaker + TokenStore; P1: TaskRegistry + ObservabilityEmitter + ExactMatchCache; P2: ToolDefinition registry + vMCP bundle scoping.
constraints: No circular imports: unified_server imports from nosai.mcp.* submodules, never vice-versa
All existing orchestrator tool signatures identical to scripts/mcp_server.py (employee_id param kept)
All existing hub tool signatures identical to nosai/mcp/server.py
_STATO_CHIAMATA remains threading.local for backward compat with tests
DeepSeek chiamato solo su api.deepseek.com via call_deepseek, mai OpenRouter
ObservabilityEmitter.emit() chiamato in ogni tool che chiama un modello remoto
TokenStore legge env vars a ogni chiamata (non all avvio) per supportare rotazione senza restart
ExactMatchCache applicata a preflight_contract_check (payload hash SHA256, TTL 24h, SQLite)

new_classes.name: CircuitBreaker
new_classes.doc: Circuit breaker a tre stati per tool cloud. Thread-safe. Default thresholds: cloud_infill=3 failures/60s, deep_reasoner=2/30s, preflight=5/20s.
methods: def __init__(self, thresholds: dict[str, int] | None = None, cooldowns: dict[str, float] | None = None) -> None
def call(self, tool: str, fn: Callable[[], Any]) -> Any  # raises RuntimeError se OPEN
def _record_failure(self, tool: str) -> None  # incrementa contatore, apre se >= soglia
def _record_success(self, tool: str) -> None  # azzera fallimenti, chiude

new_classes.name: TaskRegistry
new_classes.doc: Registry in-memory di task asincroni. submit restituisce task_id. Thread-safe.
methods: def submit(self, tool_name: str, args: dict) -> str  # restituisce task_id uuid
def get(self, task_id: str) -> dict  # KeyError se non esiste
def update(self, task_id: str, progress: int, message: str = '') -> dict
def complete(self, task_id: str, result: str) -> dict
def fail(self, task_id: str, error: str) -> dict

new_classes.name: ObservabilityEmitter
new_classes.doc: Emette log strutturato JSON con trace_id e span_id per ogni chiamata modello.
methods: def begin_trace(self) -> str  # genera uuid4, lo salva in _local.trace_id, lo restituisce
def emit(self, tool: str, model: str, duration_ms: float, tokens_in: int, tokens_out: int, cost_usd: float, status: str, **extra: Any) -> None  # scrive JSON su logger.info
def current_trace_id(self) -> str  # restituisce _local.trace_id o stringa vuota

new_classes.name: ExactMatchCache
new_classes.doc: Cache L1 exact-match SQLite. Chiave = SHA256 hex del payload. TTL default 86400s.
methods: def __init__(self, db_path: Path, ttl_seconds: int = 86400) -> None  # crea tabella se non esiste
def get(self, payload: str) -> str | None  # None se assente o scaduto
def put(self, payload: str, result: str) -> None

call_deepseek(model_id, prompt, system_prompt, temperature=0.1, max_tokens=4096) -> str
